<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="cli-command-contract">
<h1>CLI Command Contract</h1>
<p>Taskledger uses a task-first command grammar:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger [--root PATH] [--json] &lt;area&gt; &lt;verb&gt; [RESOURCE_REF] [--task TASK_REF] [options]
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="global-options">
<h2>Global Options</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--root</span> <span class="pre">PATH</span></code> selects the workspace root.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> is root-level only and must appear before the command group.</p></li>
<li><p>Command-local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> options are not part of the public contract.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--cwd</span></code> remains accepted as a compatibility root alias, but docs and examples
should prefer <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--root</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="task-scoping">
<h2>Task Scoping</h2>
<p>Task-scoped workflow commands default to the active task. Use
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--task</span> <span class="pre">TASK_REF</span></code> when explicitly targeting another task.</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>start
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>start<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>resume<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Reacquire implementation lock.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>restart<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Fix validation findings.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>finish<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Implemented.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>snapshot<span class="w"> </span>refresh<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Accept current workspace as the implementation snapshot.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>review<span class="w"> </span>record<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--result<span class="w"> </span>pass<span class="w"> </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;No blocking issues.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>status<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0001
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Task-resource commands accept the task as their direct positional resource:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>task-0001
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>cancel<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Duplicate&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>archive<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Hide historical task&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>unarchive<span class="w"> </span>task-0001<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Restore task&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>report<span class="w"> </span>task-0001
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>tl:task-0001
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>tl-task-0001
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Reference parsing helpers are available:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ref<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>task-0001
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ref<span class="w"> </span>parse<span class="w"> </span>TL-TASK-0001
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Fresh-session and monitoring commands are top-level read surfaces:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>usage<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>-q<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>usage
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>monitor<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--refresh-seconds<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2</span><span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--once<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--max-events<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">10</span><span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--max-ready<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">10</span><span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--plain<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--no-clear<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Optional positional task refs are not supported for workflow commands.</p>
</section>
<section id="plan-guidance-command">
<h2>Plan guidance command</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">guidance</span></code> is a read-only planning helper command that always
prints built-in plan-input guidance. When a project prompt profile is configured
it appends project-local advisory guidance:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>guidance<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="p">|</span>json<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>defaults to the active task when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--task</span></code> is omitted;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--format</span></code> accepts only <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">markdown</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">json</span></code>;</p></li>
<li><p>when a planning run is active, it records a one-time guidance-view marker for
that run and appends a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan.guidance.viewed</span></code> event;</p></li>
<li><p>root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> continues to return the standard CLI success/error envelope;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">has_project_guidance</span></code> indicates whether a project prompt profile exists,
not whether any guidance is available. Built-in guidance is always returned.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The command payload shape is:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_id</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">has_project_guidance</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">guidance</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">profile</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">question_policy</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="plan-revision-commands">
<h2>Plan revision commands</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">export</span></code> renders an editable plan draft outside durable
storage, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">amend</span></code> applies structured plan-review edits:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--version<span class="w"> </span>latest<span class="p">|</span>N<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--file<span class="w"> </span>PATH<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--overwrite<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--stdout<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>amend<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--drop-criterion<span class="w"> </span>CRITERION_ID<span class="w"> </span>...<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--drop-todo<span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="w"> </span>...<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--remove-file<span class="w"> </span>PATH<span class="w"> </span>...<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;...&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Plan proposal commands that accept <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--file</span></code> reject file paths under
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> because that directory is private durable ledger state.</p>
</section>
<section id="plan-check-command">
<h2>Plan check command</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> validates editable plan input without creating,
revising, proposing, accepting, locking, or releasing anything:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--file<span class="w"> </span>PATH<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--strict<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--file</span></code> defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan.md</span></code> when omitted;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--strict</span></code> upgrades unknown-field warnings to errors and fails on any warning;</p></li>
<li><p>task context is optional; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_id</span></code> appears in the payload when resolvable;</p></li>
<li><p>JSON uses the root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> option:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--file<span class="w"> </span>./plan.md
</pre></div>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Payload shape:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_input_check</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_id</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">passed</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">strict</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">summary</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">{errors,</span> <span class="pre">warnings}</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issues</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parsed</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="plan-schema-command">
<h2>Plan schema command</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">schema</span></code> prints the editable plan input schema and one valid
example:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>schema
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Payload shape:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_input_schema</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="plan-review-command">
<h2>Plan review command</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">review</span></code> is a read-only approval-facing plan renderer:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>review<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--version<span class="w"> </span>N<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="p">|</span>json<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>-o<span class="w"> </span>PATH<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>defaults to the active task when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--task</span></code> is omitted;</p></li>
<li><p>defaults to the latest proposed plan in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_review</span></code> stage when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--version</span></code> is omitted;</p></li>
<li><p>renders Markdown by default and can emit JSON-formatted content with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code>;</p></li>
<li><p>when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-o/--output</span></code> is provided, writes rendered content to a file path.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Taskledger stores task-local work state and opaque links. Cross-ledger
semantics belong to an organizer such as ledgerdeck.</p>
<p>Relevant commands for external artifact references:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>link<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>--url<span class="w"> </span>specs/behavior/features/checkout/payment.feature<span class="w"> </span>--label<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;behavior spec&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>file<span class="w"> </span>link<span class="w"> </span>specs/behavior/features/checkout/payment.feature<span class="w"> </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span>doc<span class="w"> </span>--label<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;behavior spec&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--criterion<span class="w"> </span>ac-0001<span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>pass<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest tests/test_checkout_payment.py::test_payment_flow&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Links are opaque. Taskledger does not parse or interpret linked files.</p></li>
<li><p>Validation evidence is recorded through generic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code>.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="archive-import-lock-policy">
<h2>Archive import lock policy</h2>
<p>Archive imports support explicit lock handling:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>import<span class="w"> </span>./taskledger-transfer.tar.gz<span class="w"> </span>--replace<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--lock-policy<span class="w"> </span>drop<span class="p">|</span>quarantine<span class="p">|</span>keep<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>import<span class="w"> </span>./taskledger-task-&lt;project&gt;-&lt;ledger&gt;-task-0040-&lt;ts&gt;.tar.gz<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--id-policy<span class="w"> </span>preserve<span class="p">|</span>renumber-on-conflict<span class="p">|</span>fail-on-conflict<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The default is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">quarantine</span></code> so imported source-machine runtime locks are not
restored as active <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock.yaml</span></code> files. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">keep</span></code> is diagnostic-only behavior
for full-fidelity lock restoration.</p>
</section>
<section id="transfer-archive-manifest-contract">
<h2>Transfer archive manifest contract</h2>
<p>Transfer archives include both machine identity and human-readable metadata:
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.project.name</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.project.slug</span></code> are display metadata,
while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manifest.project.uuid</span></code> remains the safety identity.</p>
<div class="highlight-json notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">&quot;project&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">&quot;uuid&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;project_uuid&gt;&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">&quot;name&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;project_name&gt;&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">&quot;slug&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;project_slug&gt;&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">&quot;ledger_ref&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;ledger_ref&gt;&quot;</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Import compatibility is backward-safe: older archives that only contain
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">project.uuid</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">project.ledger_ref</span></code> remain valid. UUID comparison is
still authoritative for import safety.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">import</span> <span class="pre">--dry-run</span></code> must not mutate taskledger state for either
archive or JSON payload imports.</p>
</section>
<section id="export-task-selection">
<h2>Export task selection</h2>
<p>Taskledger export supports full-ledger and task-scoped archives:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>./backup.tar.gz
taskledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>task-0040
taskledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>task-0040
taskledger<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>task-0040<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>./task0040.tar.gz
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="positional-resource-refs">
<h2>Positional Resource Refs</h2>
<p>Positional refs are reserved for the direct resource being changed or shown:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span>TITLE<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>options<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>record<span class="w"> </span>TITLE<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>options<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>activate<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>follow-up<span class="w"> </span>PARENT_REF<span class="w"> </span>TITLE<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>options<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>todo<span class="w"> </span><span class="k">done</span><span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--evidence<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pytest -q&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>question<span class="w"> </span>answer<span class="w"> </span>QUESTION_ID<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--text<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Yes.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>HANDOFF_ID<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>require<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>REQUIRED_TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">0</span>.4.1
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="release-commands">
<h2>Release commands</h2>
<p>Release boundaries are durable project records, not task lifecycle states:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>tag<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">0</span>.4.1<span class="w"> </span>--at-task<span class="w"> </span>task-0030<span class="w"> </span>--note<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;0.4.1 released&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>list
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">0</span>.4.1
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">tag</span></code> writes a durable release record under the current ledger’s
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releases/</span></code> directory. Release boundaries must point to done tasks.
Taskledger does not provide changelog entry, changelog context, or
<a class="reference internal" href="../changelog/"><span class="std std-doc">docs/changelog.md</span></a> build commands; those belong to the separate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span></code>
tool. Load both skills when cross-ledger release notes need task context.</p>
</section>
<section id="legacy-branch-scoped-ledger-commands-migration-only">
<h2>Legacy branch-scoped ledger commands (migration only)</h2>
<p>In legacy projects without a canonical manifest, branch-scoped ledgers isolate
ignored local task state by the checked-in
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger_ref</span></code> stored in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>list
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>fork<span class="w"> </span>feature-a
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>switch<span class="w"> </span>main
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>adopt<span class="w"> </span>--from<span class="w"> </span>feature-a<span class="w"> </span>task-0030
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger</span> <span class="pre">fork</span></code> creates a new local namespace under
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/ledgers/&lt;ref&gt;/</span></code> and updates only Taskledger-owned ledger keys in
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger</span> <span class="pre">switch</span></code> changes the checked-in pointer to an
existing local ledger. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledger</span> <span class="pre">adopt</span></code> copies a task from another local ledger
into the current ledger and renumbers on collision.</p>
</section>
<section id="storage-and-sync-helper-commands">
<h2>Storage and sync helper commands</h2>
<p>Taskledger also exposes local storage discovery and sync helpers:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>storage<span class="w"> </span>where
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>storage<span class="w"> </span>move<span class="w"> </span>--to<span class="w"> </span>../taskledger-state/project-a<span class="w"> </span>--mode<span class="w"> </span>copy<span class="p">|</span>move<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--adopt-existing<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--force<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>preflight
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>commit<span class="w"> </span>--message<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Sync project-a taskledger state&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>--output<span class="w"> </span>./taskledger-transfer.tar.gz
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>import<span class="w"> </span>./taskledger-transfer.tar.gz<span class="w"> </span>--dry-run
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--repo<span class="w"> </span>../taskledger-state<span class="w"> </span>--project-path<span class="w"> </span>project-a
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>commit<span class="w"> </span>--message<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Sync project-a taskledger state&quot;</span>
<span class="nb">cd</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="k">$(</span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">cd</span><span class="k">)</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
git<span class="w"> </span>pull<span class="w"> </span>--ff-only
git<span class="w"> </span>push
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>hooks<span class="w"> </span>install
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>hooks<span class="w"> </span>status
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>sync<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>hooks<span class="w"> </span>uninstall
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">storage</span> <span class="pre">where</span></code> is read-only and reports the resolved workspace root,
config path, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger_dir</span></code>, project identity, ledger ref, Git detection,
and active lock count.</p></li>
<li><p>In legacy projects, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">storage</span> <span class="pre">move</span></code> updates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> atomically after the target has
been copied or explicitly adopted.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">preflight</span></code> performs only local checks. It must not perform network
push/pull operations.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">status</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">commit</span></code> operate only on the Git repository that
contains the resolved <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger_dir</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">export</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">import</span></code> are archive aliases for the root
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">export</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">import</span></code> commands.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sync</span> <span class="pre">git</span></code> commands operate on a private external Git repository that stores
full project taskledger state under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;repo&gt;/&lt;project_path&gt;</span></code>.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="config-commands">
<h2>Config commands</h2>
<p>Project config inspection and edits are available under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>list
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>show
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>keys
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>get<span class="w"> </span>prompt_profiles.planning.max_required_questions
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>describe<span class="w"> </span>prompt_profiles.planning.plan_body_detail
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="w"> </span>prompt_profiles.planning.max_required_questions<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">3</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="w"> </span>prompt_profiles.planning.question_policy<span class="w"> </span>always_before_plan
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>dotted keys target nested TOML tables (for example
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prompt_profiles.planning.max_required_questions</span></code>);</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span> <span class="pre">keys</span></code> lists available key names and path patterns;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span> <span class="pre">describe</span></code> provides key semantics, allowed values, defaults, and
whether a key is explicitly set;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span> <span class="pre">set</span></code> accepts TOML literals (numbers, booleans, arrays, inline
tables); when TOML parsing fails, the value is treated as a plain string;</p></li>
<li><p>invalid values are rejected using standard LaunchError JSON/human envelopes.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="next-action-result-contract">
<h2><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> result contract</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">next-action</span></code> is the preferred fresh-context entrypoint for agents
and operators. It should identify the next concrete question, todo, criterion,
plan, dependency, or repair target instead of only naming a lifecycle bucket.</p>
<p>Human output should stay concise but actionable:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>todo-work: Implementation is in progress; 1 todos remain.
Next todo: todo-0001 -- Update next-action JSON payload.
Command: taskledger todo show todo-0001
Worker step: tester
Worker context: taskledger pipeline context tester
Worker handoff: taskledger handoff create --worker tester --summary &quot;...&quot;
Mark todo done after evidence exists: taskledger todo done todo-0001 --evidence &quot;...&quot;
Progress: 0/1 todos done
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>JSON output preserves the existing fields:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_id</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status_stage</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_stage</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">action</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reason</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">blocking</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_command</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p>and may also include:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_item</span></code> for the concrete target</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">commands</span></code> for ordered command hints with one primary command</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">progress</span></code> for question, todo, or validation queues</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_pipeline</span></code> when an enabled <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">guided</span></code> worker pipeline has a pending
step; this object includes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">enabled</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_step</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context_command</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff_command</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template_command</span></code> plus <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">required_plan_fields</span></code> and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">recommended_plan_fields</span></code> when the next step is regenerating a plan from
answered questions</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">guidance_command</span></code> when planning guidance should be reviewed before drafting
or regenerating a plan</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Agents should inspect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_item</span></code>, prefer <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next_command</span></code> when it is safe,
avoid inventing question answers, and never mark todos done without evidence.</p>
<p>When a task is in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">failed_validation</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> should direct agents
back to implementation with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">restart</span> <span class="pre">--summary</span> <span class="pre">SUMMARY</span></code>.</p>
<p>When a task persists <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planning</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementing</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validating</span></code> as its
status but <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_stage</span></code> is missing, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> must not report
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">The</span> <span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">is</span> <span class="pre">cancelled.</span></code> For an orphaned implementation with a still-running
latest implementation run and no active lock, it should direct agents to
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">resume</span> <span class="pre">--task</span> <span class="pre">TASK_REF</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code>.</p>
<p>For an implemented task whose validation is blocked by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">IMPLEMENTATION_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> must point to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate-reconcile</span></code> and the audited recovery command
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">snapshot</span> <span class="pre">refresh</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code>, not to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">restart</span></code> unless
the task is actually in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">failed_validation</span></code>.
For an approved task with a non-implementation run still marked running,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code> must not direct agents to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">start</span></code>.
It should report a repair-oriented action and point to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span></code>.
Truly cancelled tasks recover through
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">uncancel</span> <span class="pre">--task</span> <span class="pre">TASK_REF</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code></p>
<section id="compact-mutation-output">
<h3>Compact mutation output</h3>
<p>Mutation commands emit compact acknowledgements instead of full task or run records.
This reduces LLM context consumption during implementation loops.</p>
<p>The following commands produce compact output:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code>: emits <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo_added</span></code> result with new todo, progress, and next command.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">done</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">undone</span></code>: emits <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo_update</span></code> result with todo id, status, progress, and next command.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code>: emits <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_lifecycle</span></code> result with task id, run id, status, and next command.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Human mode shows a one-line summary:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>added todo-0001 on task-0001  (0/3 done)
done todo-0001 on task-0001  (1/3 done)
finished implementation run-0001  task task-0001 -&gt; implemented
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>JSON mode wraps the compact result in the standard success envelope with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result_type</span></code>.</p>
<p>For full task, run, or todo details after a mutation, use:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">show</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">status</span></code> for task-level detail.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">show</span> <span class="pre">TODO_ID</span></code> for individual todo detail.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">next-action</span></code> for the next concrete step.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">next</span></code> for the next open todo.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>to a durable non-active stage rather than directly re-entering an active stage.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="run-and-lock-repair">
<h2>Run and lock repair</h2>
</section>
<section id="managed-command-wrappers">
<h2>Managed command wrappers</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">command</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">command</span></code> mirror the inner command exit code by
default. Both wrappers pass the argument vector after <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--</span></code> to the child without a
shell. They execute the child from the CLI invocation directory, or the explicit
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--root</span></code> directory, even when Taskledger discovers an ancestor workspace root for
ledger state, artifacts, and logs.</p>
<p>Managed commands preserve the caller environment, but resolve child executable lookup
deterministically. A usable inherited <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VIRTUAL_ENV</span></code> takes precedence. Otherwise
Taskledger checks <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;command-cwd&gt;/.venv</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;command-cwd&gt;/venv</span></code>, then the workspace
root’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.venv</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">venv</span></code>, in that order. A candidate must contain <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pyvenv.cfg</span></code> and
a platform-appropriate Python executable. For an auto-detected environment, only
the child environment is changed: its scripts directory is prepended to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PATH</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VIRTUAL_ENV</span></code> is set, and inherited <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PYTHONHOME</span></code> is removed. If no candidate is
valid, the inherited environment is used unchanged. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PYTHONPATH</span></code> is preserved.
This does not rewrite argv, invoke a shell, change the parent environment, or
activate project environments for Taskledger’s internal subprocesses. Portable
commands such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">python</span> <span class="pre">-m</span> <span class="pre">pytest</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pytest</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ruff</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mypy</span></code> remain valid.</p>
<p>Captured stdout and stderr are included in the command result. Human mode emits
those streams before the recorded-command summary, while JSON mode keeps them only
inside the single JSON result envelope. The result and managed-shell log also record
the child cwd. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-failure</span></code> changes only the wrapper exit code; the recorded
child exit code and failed check remain unchanged.</p>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-failure</span></code> when you intentionally want to record a non-zero inner
exit code while returning wrapper exit code <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>tests/<span class="w"> </span>-q
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--allow-failure<span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>tests/<span class="w"> </span>-q
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>ruff<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--config<span class="o">=</span>.ruff.toml<span class="w"> </span>.
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">command</span><span class="w"> </span>--allow-failure<span class="w"> </span>--<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-c<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;raise SystemExit(7)&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="transcript-review-modes">
<h2>Transcript review modes</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">transcript</span></code> defaults to review mode, which groups wrapper +
managed-shell pairs, highlights failures and wrapper/managed mismatches, and
flags late lifecycle commands. Raw per-record audit table is available with
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--raw</span></code>.</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>transcript<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>transcript<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--raw
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span>transcript<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--failures
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--review</span></code> is the default (no flag needed). <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--raw</span></code> shows every record
without collapsing. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--failures</span></code> renders only failed command rows and retry
detection. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--raw</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--review</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--failures</span></code> are mutually exclusive.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">export</span></code> writes a Markdown file with a deterministic body combining a curated
archive report, raw task-bundle record files, and optional source-file snapshots.
It is the recommended command for handing a task to an LLM/coding agent.</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>task.llm.md
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--no-source-files<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>task.records.md
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>task.llm.md
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span> <span class="pre">locks</span></code> report running runs without
matching active locks. Orphaned running planning runs can be finished only
through an explicit repair command with a reason:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>repair<span class="w"> </span>run<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="w"> </span>--run<span class="w"> </span>RUN_ID<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Planning was already completed.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The repair command refuses to finish non-planning runs, non-running runs, or
runs that still have a matching active lock.</p>
</section>
<section id="post-completion-follow-up-deltas">
<h2>Post-completion follow-up deltas</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">follow-up</span> <span class="pre">PARENT_REF</span> <span class="pre">TITLE</span></code> is the supported path for small
post-completion changes. It requires a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code> parent task, creates a new draft
child task with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parent_task_id</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parent_relation=follow_up</span></code>, and keeps
the parent task terminal.</p>
</section>
<section id="human-monitoring-ui">
<h2>Human monitoring UI</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">usage</span></code> is the compact fresh-session startup command:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>usage<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>-q<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>--json<span class="w"> </span>usage
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>it is read-only and must not claim handoffs, repair locks, or mutate task
state;</p></li>
<li><p>root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> returns the standard CLI envelope with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result.kind</span> <span class="pre">==</span> <span class="pre">&quot;usage&quot;</span></code>;</p></li>
<li><p>it summarizes actor, harness, active work, inbox items, and ready tasks;</p></li>
<li><p>agents should continue to use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">next</span></code>, and other JSON
commands as the canonical same-session automation interface.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">monitor</span></code> is the dependency-free human-oriented terminal monitor:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>monitor<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--refresh-seconds<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2</span><span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--once<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--max-events<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">10</span><span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--max-ready<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">10</span><span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--plain<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--no-clear<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>it is read-only and never mutates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger/</span></code> state;</p></li>
<li><p>root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> prints a single <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">monitor_snapshot</span></code> payload and exits;</p></li>
<li><p>non-JSON mode refreshes on a timer until interrupted;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--plain</span></code> disables styling and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-clear</span></code> appends snapshots instead of
clearing the terminal;</p></li>
<li><p>it replaces the removed server/TUI surface; agents should keep using JSON
commands for automation.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="focused-context-and-handoff-options">
<h2>Focused context and handoff options</h2>
</section>
<section id="code-review-commands">
<h2>Code review commands</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review</span></code> stores optional durable code-review evidence without adding a new
lifecycle stage. Review evidence may be recorded before validation or after a
task has reached <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">done</span></code>; storing the review remains append-only and does not
reopen the completed task:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>review<span class="w"> </span>record<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span>--result<span class="w"> </span>pass<span class="p">|</span>fail<span class="p">|</span>blocked<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">(</span>--summary<span class="w"> </span>TEXT<span class="w"> </span><span class="p">|</span><span class="w"> </span>--summary-file<span class="w"> </span>PATH<span class="o">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--from-git<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--commit<span class="w"> </span>COMMIT<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--worker<span class="w"> </span>STEP_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--handoff<span class="w"> </span>HANDOFF_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--run<span class="w"> </span>RUN_ID<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>review<span class="w"> </span>list<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>review<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>REVIEW_REF<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>JSON mode returns a stable payload with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;code_review_recorded&quot;</span></code> for
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review</span> <span class="pre">record</span></code> and includes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">review_id</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task_id</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementation_run</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_step_id</span></code>, and compact git
metadata fields when present.</p>
<p>When a user explicitly asks an agent for a review, the agent should persist
the final review with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">review</span> <span class="pre">record</span></code> before answering. A
chat-only review is not durable task evidence. Post-completion review
records are append-only and do not reopen the task.</p>
<p>Focused worker contexts keep lifecycle <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode</span></code> separate from worker-role
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--for</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>--for<span class="w"> </span>planner<span class="p">|</span>implementer<span class="p">|</span>validator<span class="p">|</span>spec-reviewer<span class="p">|</span>code-reviewer<span class="p">|</span>reviewer<span class="p">|</span>full<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--scope<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="p">|</span>todo<span class="p">|</span>run<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--todo<span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--run<span class="w"> </span>RUN_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="p">|</span>json<span class="p">|</span>text<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span>--mode<span class="w"> </span>planning<span class="p">|</span>implementation<span class="p">|</span>validation<span class="p">|</span>review<span class="p">|</span>full<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--for<span class="w"> </span>planner<span class="p">|</span>implementer<span class="p">|</span>validator<span class="p">|</span>spec-reviewer<span class="p">|</span>code-reviewer<span class="p">|</span>reviewer<span class="p">|</span>full<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--scope<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="p">|</span>todo<span class="p">|</span>run<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--todo<span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--run<span class="w"> </span>RUN_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span>--worker<span class="w"> </span>STEP_ID<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--scope<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="p">|</span>todo<span class="p">|</span>run<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--todo<span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--run<span class="w"> </span>RUN_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>pipeline<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>STEP_ID<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--scope<span class="w"> </span>task<span class="p">|</span>todo<span class="p">|</span>run<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--todo<span class="w"> </span>TODO_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--run<span class="w"> </span>RUN_ID<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="p">|</span>json<span class="p">|</span>text<span class="o">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>handoff<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>HANDOFF_ID<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>text<span class="p">|</span>markdown<span class="p">|</span>json<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK_REF<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Rules:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--todo</span></code> implies <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--scope</span> <span class="pre">todo</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--run</span></code> implies <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--scope</span> <span class="pre">run</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--scope</span> <span class="pre">todo</span></code> requires <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--todo</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--scope</span> <span class="pre">run</span></code> requires <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--run</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--for</span> <span class="pre">implementation|validation|planning|review|full</span></code> remain accepted as
compatibility aliases.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff</span> <span class="pre">create</span> <span class="pre">--worker</span></code> derives mode and context from the configured
worker step and stores <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">worker_step_id</span></code> in the handoff record.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipeline</span> <span class="pre">context</span> <span class="pre">STEP_ID</span></code> is equivalent to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context</span> <span class="pre">--worker</span> <span class="pre">STEP_ID</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spec-reviewer</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code-reviewer</span></code> worker contexts require <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--run</span></code> or
explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--scope</span> <span class="pre">task</span></code> when they are not bound to a validation/review run.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">handoff</span> <span class="pre">show</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">markdown</span></code> prints the stored snapshot body.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="removed-pre-release-aliases">
<h2>Removed Pre-Release Aliases</h2>
<p>These aliases are intentionally not registered:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">new</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">clear-active</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">add-change</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">add-check</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">file</span> <span class="pre">unlink</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">link</span> <span class="pre">link</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">link</span> <span class="pre">unlink</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">create</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">task</span> <span class="pre">deactivate</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">change</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">file</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">file</span> <span class="pre">remove</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">link</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code>, and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">link</span> <span class="pre">remove</span></code> instead.</p>
</section>
<section id="approval-escape-hatches">
<h2>Approval escape hatches</h2>
<p>Plan approval escape hatches require <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--reason</span></code> to prevent silent bypass:</p>
<p>Approval also requires <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--note</span></code> for user approval. Agent approval additionally
requires <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-agent-approval</span> <span class="pre">--reason</span> <span class="pre">&quot;...&quot;</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="todo-source-inference">
<h2>Todo source inference</h2>
<p>When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">todo</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code> is called without an explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--source</span></code>, the source is
inferred from the active lock:</p>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Active lock stage</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Inferred source</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementing</span></code></p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">implementer</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planning</span></code></p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planner</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>No active lock</p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">user</span></code></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Plan-materialized todos always use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source=plan</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="storage-compatibility">
<h2>Storage Compatibility</h2>
<p>Taskledger stores canonical project configuration in schema-3 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.toml</span></code>
and Taskledger config in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/taskledger/config.toml</span></code>. Legacy
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger.toml</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.taskledger.toml</span></code> remain readable for explicit migration.</p>
<p>The default <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">data</span></code> mount is persistent external storage at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">../ledger</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">indexes</span></code>
is cache storage. A local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.local.toml</span></code> may select <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">user-data</span></code>.
Commands keep <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--root</span></code> scoped to the source workspace, not the storage root.</p>
<p>Taskledger uses:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>storage layout version 5 in the UUID-scoped data root’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">storage.yaml</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>schema-2 canonical ledger state</p></li>
<li><p>per-record <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema_version</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>per-record <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">object_type</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>per-file <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">file_version</span></code> for durable Markdown/YAML/JSON record files</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Storage layout history is maintained by explicit migration receipts. The
current layout keeps branch-scoped ledgers under
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;data-root&gt;/ledgers/&lt;ledger_ref&gt;/</span></code>.</p>
<p>Taskledger does not silently rewrite storage during read-only commands.</p>
<p>If the installed taskledger version can read but not write an older workspace,
it reports that migration is required.</p>
<p>To migrate:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>storage<span class="w"> </span>validate
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>migrate<span class="w"> </span>plan
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>migrate<span class="w"> </span>apply
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>After migration to layout 5, verify health with:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>ledger<span class="w"> </span>doctor
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Checkout-scoped indexes under the resolved cache mount are optional derived
caches or registries. Read-only commands continue to work from canonical
Markdown/YAML records and do not initialize a missing cache. Before a canonical
mutation, Taskledger initializes a missing or empty cache binding and rebuilds
the derived indexes. A non-empty cache without its binding marker is atomically
quarantined beside the cache and rebuilt from canonical records. Conflicting or
invalid markers, symlinks, and non-directory cache paths are not adopted
automatically. The remaining derived caches may be plain JSON arrays with no
version metadata and can be rebuilt explicitly with:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>reindex
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">repair</span> <span class="pre">index</span></code> uses the same recovery path and reports any quarantine
location. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">indexes</span></code> mount is fixed to cache storage, so
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">storage</span> <span class="pre">set</span> <span class="pre">indexes</span> <span class="pre">cache</span></code> is an idempotent topology request;
non-cache indexes storage is rejected directly.</p>
<p>A newer storage version than the installed taskledger supports is rejected with
a clear error.</p>
</section>
<section id="lock-recovery-contract">
<h2>Lock recovery contract</h2>
<p>Lock diagnostics are exposed through three surfaces:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">lock</span> <span class="pre">show</span> <span class="pre">--task</span> <span class="pre">TASK</span></code> returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">diagnostics</span></code> object and
a structured human block. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">classification</span></code> field names the lock
state: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">expired</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_dead_local_process</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_live_local_process</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_unverifiable_remote_or_unknown_process</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_no_pid</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_same_actor</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_other_actor</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">--json</span> <span class="pre">next-action</span></code> returns <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock_status</span></code> whenever a lock
exists, and sets <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">action=repair-lock</span></code> with a diagnostics blocker when the
active implementation lock has a dead local holder PID.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">taskledger</span> <span class="pre">implement</span> <span class="pre">resume</span> <span class="pre">--repair-expired-lock</span></code> returns a
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LOCK_CONFLICT</span></code> error (exit code 4) with diagnostics and remediation
commands when the existing lock is non-expired.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--repair-expired-lock</span></code> is not a general stale-lock takeover flag. It only
applies to locks whose <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">expires_at</span></code> is in the past. For non-expired active
locks, follow the classification returned by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lock</span> <span class="pre">show</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next-action</span></code>.</p>
<p>For non-expired active locks classified as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_dead_local_process</span></code>, the
canonical recovery sequence is:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>taskledger<span class="w"> </span>repair<span class="w"> </span>lock<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Holder PID ... is no longer running.&quot;</span>
taskledger<span class="w"> </span>implement<span class="w"> </span>resume<span class="w"> </span>--task<span class="w"> </span>TASK<span class="w"> </span>--reason<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Reacquire implementation lock after stale holder repair.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_live_local_process</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">active_other_actor</span></code>, do not repair;
use a handoff or wait for the holder to release. For
